name: The Noor Project
mission: The Noor Project works towards overcoming poverty, illness, and illiteracy with both short and long-term approaches. Our mission is rooted in self-sufficiency, empowering poverty-stricken communities with tools and resources including education, mindset training, and employment.
theoryOfChange: We aim at the root causes of poverty among families in Pakistan to stop the cycle from repeating. We enroll families into programs that meet their needs. Once their member graduates from our vocational course and secures employment, the family is taken off the list for the ration packets and the empty spot is given to another family in need.

strengths_deep_dive: The Noor Project channels resources directly into community-level programs in Pakistan. The organization maintains an <cite id="1">82.6% program expense ratio</cite>, which surpasses the standard industry benchmark of 75%. Funding supports several core community projects, including a <cite id="1">grammar school, a free health clinic and pharmacy, a food bank, and technical and vocational training</cite>. In FY2024, the charity brought in <cite id="2">$1,759,964 in total revenue</cite>, representing a multi-year growth trajectory that expands its operational reach.
rich_narrative.summary: For the Needy & Hungry Foundation Inc, operating as The Noor Project, delivers direct education, healthcare, and vocational services to families living in poverty in Pakistan. In FY2024, the organization generated <cite id="2">$1,759,964 in total revenue</cite>, reflecting strong growth. The charity directs its resources toward immediate direct services, including a <cite id="1">grammar school and a community health clinic and pharmacy</cite>. The Noor Project operates with a cash-adjusted <cite id="1">program expense ratio of 82.6%</cite>, ensuring that most of its spending goes directly into program delivery rather than administrative overhead. <cite id="3">Zakat-eligible programs</cite> form a core part of its fundraising strategy, and the organization maintains a <cite id="3">dedicated Zakat calculator</cite> for donors. While the organization provides direct relief to vulnerable communities, its reported beneficiary figures suggest an exceptionally low per-person cost that warrants further verification. Overall, the organization balances effective community service delivery with areas for improvement in formal outcome tracking.
